October 29, 2026 
 
To, 
The General Manager, 
Department of Corporate Services, 
BSE Limited, 
P.J. Towers, Dalal Street, 
Mumbai – 400001 
Scrip Code No.: 543972 
To, 
The Listing Department. 
National Stock Exchange of India Limited 
Exchange Plaza, C-1, Block G 
Bandra Kurla Complex 
Bandra (E), Mumbai – 400 051 
Trading Symbol: AEROFLEX 
 
 
Subject
:
Intimation of Audio Recording of Investors’ Conference Call held on 29th 
October, 2026 for the Quarter and Half Year ended 30th September, 2026
 
 
Dear Sir/Ma’am, 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 and Regulation 46 read with Clause 15 of Para A of Part A of Schedule 
III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we hereby 
inform you that the audio recording of the Investors' Conference Call held on Thursday, October 
29, 2026, in respect of the financial results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 
September 30, 2026, has been uploaded on the website of the Company and can be accessed at 
the following link: 
 
https://www.aeroflexindia.com/uploads/topics/17932714286574.mp3 
 
Kindly take the above information on record. 
 
 
Thanking you 
 
 
Yours faithfully, 
 
For AEROFLEX INDUSTRIES LIMITED 
 
 
 
Ruthu Parampogi 
Company Secretary & Compliance Officer  
Membership No.: A60982 
 
 
Encl: As stated above 
Ruthu John 
Parampogi
Digitally signed by 
Ruthu John Parampogi 
Date: 2026.10.29
